Deprecated and defunct functions

deprecated.Rd

Deprecated and defunct functions

Usage

MgnifyClient(
  username = NULL,
  password = NULL,
  useCache = FALSE,
  cacheDir = tempdir(),
  ...
)

getResult(
  x,
  accession,
  get.taxa = "SSU",
  get.func = TRUE,
  output = "TreeSE",
  ...
)

searchAnalysis(x, type, accession, ...)

getMetadata(x, accession, ...)

doQuery(
  x,
  type = "studies",
  accession = NULL,
  as.df = TRUE,
  max.hits = 200,
  ...
)

getData(x, type, accession.type = NULL, accession = NULL, as.df = TRUE, ...)

searchFile(
  x,
  accession,
  type = c("studies", "samples", "analyses", "assemblies", "genomes", "run"),
  ...
)

getFile(x, url, file = NULL, read.func = NULL, ...)

databaseUrl(...)

authTok(...)

useCache(...)

cacheDir(...)

showWarnings(...)

clearCache(...)

verbose(...)

databaseUrl(x) <- value

authTok(x) <- value

useCache(x) <- value

cacheDir(x) <- value

showWarnings(x) <- value

clearCache(x) <- value

verbose(x) <- value

mgnify_client(...)

mgnify_query(...)

mgnify_analyses_from_samples(...)

mgnify_analyses_from_studies(...)

mgnify_get_download_urls(...)

mgnify_download(...)

mgnify_get_analyses_results(...)

mgnify_get_analyses_phyloseq(...)

mgnify_get_analyses_metadata(...)

mgnify_retrieve_json(...)

Arguments

username, password

Webin credentials for mgnifyLogin.

useCache, cacheDir

If useCache = TRUE, cacheDir is set as the cache directory.

...

In doQuery, query parameters of the API. Otherwise ignored.

x

Ignored. Formerly a MgnifyClient object.

accession

A character vector of accessions.

get.taxa

Taxonomy to fetch, e.g., "SSU".

get.func, output

Not supported anymore.

type

The type of accessions in searchAnalysis and searchFile, or the API endpoint in doQuery and getData, e.g., "studies".

as.df

Whether to return a data.frame instead of a list.

max.hits

The maximum number of results, or NULL for all.

accession.type

The type of accessions in getData.

url

The URL of the file.

file

NULL or a path to save the file to.

read.func

NULL or a function applied to the downloaded file.

value

Ignored.

Value

See the replacing functions. doQuery, getData and searchFile return a data.frame, and getFile returns the path of the file or the result of read.func.

Details

MGnify API v1 is frozen, and MGnifyR now uses MGnify API v2. The functions of the earlier versions of MGnifyR are deprecated, and they will be removed in a future release. Where possible, they use the new functions:

  • MgnifyClient: a client is not needed anymore. Log in with mgnifyLogin to access private data, and set options(MGnifyR.cache = "path") to keep the cache between sessions. For compatibility, MgnifyClient does these, and returns NULL. The x argument of the other deprecated functions is ignored.

  • getResult: use fetchAnalyses. Only taxonomic profiles are returned, as TreeSummarizedExperiment.

  • searchAnalysis and getMetadata: use searchAnalyses.

  • doQuery and getData: use searchStudies, searchSamples or searchAnalyses. These query any endpoint of MGnify API v2, but the endpoints and filters differ from API v1.

  • searchFile and getFile: list and download the files of studies, samples or analyses.

The accessors of MgnifyClient, such as useCache, and the functions with mgnify_ prefix are defunct.

Examples

# Instead of getResult(), use fetchAnalyses()
tse <- fetchAnalyses("MGYA00383350")
